rules.name: Go Shell Command Injection
rules.recommendation: exec.Command with shell + -c passes the second argument to a shell. Use a direct command and args.

rules.name: Go math/rand For Security
rules.recommendation: math/rand is deterministic and not safe for tokens or keys. Use crypto/rand for any security-sensitive randomness.

rules.name: Go Weak Hash Import
rules.recommendation: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken. Import crypto/sha256 or crypto/sha512 for hashing security-relevant data.

rules.name: Go HTTP Server Without TLS
rules.recommendation: http.ListenAndServe serves plaintext. Use http.ListenAndServeTLS or a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

rules.name: Go unsafe Package Import
rules.recommendation: The unsafe package bypasses Go's memory and type safety. Justify each use in a code comment and prefer cgo or syscall alternatives.
